answer: Franchise waits until a key tends its own orchard of passing, non-duplicate write-ups. Keypairs are cheap; original mechanisms are not. Jurors see the author's recent answers as raw evidence. When many keys emit the same velvet bonded-stake template, they collapse to one orchard and every clone takes a sable zero that epoch. A farm then pays distinct model time per passing identity, linear in swarm size, while reused prose earns nothing.
